title: Free Everywhere, Exact on Trees: PPO's Dropped Correction Buys Sample Efficiency Under Aggressive Reuse
abstract: arXiv:2609.39634v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Common policy improvement methods, including TRPO, PPO, and GRPO, estimate policy improvement under the behavioral policy's state-visitation distribution rather than the improved policy's own. The substitution makes the objective estimable from the behavioral policy's rollouts but adds a bias growing with policy divergence, hence the trust region or clip, and hence no reuse of a batch far off-policy. We show that under history-injective dynamics, where each state is reached by exactly one history, the dropped state-visitation ratio equals the product of per-step policy ratios along the sampled prefix, on every trajectory and not only in expectation. The ratio is therefore restored exactly, from log-probabilities PPO already computes. Autoregressive generation and canonical-order constructive optimization are both history-injective. translated_title: 处处免费，树上精确：PPO被舍弃的校正项在激进复用下换取样本效率
translated_abstract: 常见的策略改进方法，包括TRPO、PPO和GRPO，都是在行为策略的状态访问分布下（而非改进后策略自身的分布下）估计策略改进。这种替代使得目标函数可以从行为策略的rollout中估计，但会引入随策略分歧增大而增长的偏差，因此需要信赖域或裁剪机制，也因此无法复用偏离较远的off-policy批次。我们证明，在历史单射动力学（history-injective dynamics）下——即每个状态恰好由唯一一条历史到达——被舍弃的状态访问比率在每一条轨迹上都等于采样前缀上逐步策略比率的乘积，而不仅仅在期望意义上成立。因此，该比率可以从PPO已经计算的log概率中被精确恢复。自回归生成和规范顺序的构造式优化都是历史单射的。精确校正需要付出随时间步长增长的重要性采样方差，因此我们将其推广为……
tldr: 该论文证明在历史单射动力学（如自回归生成）下，PPO舍弃的状态访问分布校正项可由逐步策略比率的乘积精确恢复，从而在激进复用off-policy批次时仍能保持无偏并显著提升样本效率。
en_tdlr: Under history-injective dynamics, PPO's dropped state-visitation correction can be restored exactly from per-step policy ratios, enabling unbiased and sample-efficient policy improvement even with aggressively reused off-policy batches.
